clue.text: Capital in account to get new car

indicators.note: something made new is remade, so the letters of car are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bank customer is told the account will pay for a new car.
explanation.definitionFit: Accra is the capital city of Ghana, so it is an example of a capital.

clue.text: Native graduate returns to meet first form

indicators.note: returns tells us the graduate's letters go back the other way

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
the original is the first form of something

explanation.surface: A local graduate comes home to see their old school's first-year class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns BA into AB; 'first form' sounds like a school class but means the original version.
explanation.definitionFit: An aboriginal inhabitant is one native to a place from the earliest times.

clue.text: Prison breaks contained by church scheme

indicators.note: contained by says the jumbled letters sit inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE stands for the Church of England

indicators.note: a prison break is an escape, but here breaks means the letters of prison are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A jailbreak plot is hatched with help from inside the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prison breaks' reads as jailbreaks, but 'breaks' is the anagram signal and 'contained by' puts the result inside the church.
explanation.definitionFit: To conspire is to plot together, which is what scheming as a verb means.

clue.text: Nevertheless, not to be satisfied with just part?

definitions.meaning: as an adverb this phrase means in spite of everything

definitions.text: not to be satisfied with just part?
definitions.meaning: someone wanting the whole thing is going for everything, read literally

explanation.surface: Someone concedes a point but still wants the whole share.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes the phrase literally: one who is after all of something won't settle for a part.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means notwithstanding, a synonym of nevertheless; read literally it means pursuing everything.

clue.text: They're no good by all accounts

definitions.text: They're no good by all accounts

parts.words: They're no good by all accounts
parts.note: by all accounts usually means reportedly, but here it refers to ledger accounts: sums owed that will never be paid back

explanation.surface: Some people are said by everyone to be worthless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by all accounts' pretends to mean 'everyone says so'; read as bookkeeping, these are the loans in the ledger that will never be repaid.
explanation.definitionFit: Loans that cannot be recovered are worthless entries in a company's financial records.

clue.text: They will be themselves

parts.note: alludes to the proverb that lads will always behave like lads, i.e. youngsters will be mischievous

explanation.surface: People who insist on staying true to their own nature.
explanation.walkthrough: The saying is 'X will be X'; the clue swaps the repeated word for 'themselves'.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb excuses young lads' mischief by saying they will act according to their nature.

clue.text: Leave the City with clammy weather about

indicators.note: about means the weather word goes around the City's letters

parts.note: damp weather is moist and clammy
EC is the postcode of the City of London, the financial district

explanation.surface: A commuter quits London's financial district to escape the muggy weather.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, whose postcode begins EC.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to depart suddenly, so it is a synonym for leave as a verb.

clue.text: Pacific location in which one may be found sunbathing

definitions.meaning: an atoll in the Marshall Islands, site of US nuclear tests

definitions.text: in which one may be found sunbathing
definitions.meaning: a two-piece swimsuit worn while lying in the sun

explanation.surface: A tropical island spot where a holidaymaker could be stretched out in the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: The swimsuit was named after the atoll, so both meanings share one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Bikini Atoll is a Pacific island; the bikini is also a two-piece swimsuit worn on beaches.

clue.text: Dispatch snow vehicle, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word for the vehicle is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: a sleigh is a sledge drawn over snow

explanation.surface: Someone sends off a sledge, or so we're told.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispatch can mean to kill, which is what to slay means.

clue.text: Len, a Tory, goes out in florid style

indicators.note: goes out suggests the letters fall out of order, so Len, a Tory is rearranged

explanation.surface: A Conservative called Len leaves in flamboyant fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornately means with elaborate decoration, matching florid, which describes flowery, showy style.

clue.text: Large town following legend's wisdom

indicators.note: following puts the town after the legend in the answer

parts.note: a saga is a legend or long heroic tale
a city is a large town

explanation.surface: A big town's reputation for wisdom comes from its old legend.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'legend' is 'is', a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagacity is keen judgement and discernment, a synonym of wisdom.

clue.text: Shorter game's interrupted in these days

indicators.note: the card game breaks into the abbreviation for the present era, sitting inside it

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, is the era we live in now
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: A sports match is cut short these days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game's interrupted' means the game has interrupted: BRIDGE splits A and D.
explanation.definitionFit: An abridged text has been cut down, so it is shorter than the original.

clue.text: I'm standing by for each one left and put in jeopardy

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
per means for each, as in miles per hour
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone waiting by each one abandoned has endangered them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standing by' just places the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: To imperil something is to endanger it, which is exactly to put it in jeopardy.

clue.text: Attack lazy fellow

definitions.meaning: to ... someone is to set upon them with blows
an idle person who avoids work

explanation.surface: Someone lays into an idle man.
explanation.walkthrough: As two words, 'lay about' is a phrasal verb for hitting out on all sides.
explanation.definitionFit: Lay about is an idiom for violent attack; as one word it is a noun for an idler.

clue.text: A drink knocked over runs quickly and dries up

indicators.note: a glass knocked over is upended, so the drink's letters are turned round

parts.note: port is a fortified wine
to hie is to hurry, so hies means runs quickly

explanation.surface: Someone knocks over a drink, dashes off, and it dries up.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that atrophies withers and wastes away, which is a figurative sense of drying up.

clue.text: Riding breeches? No, but riders do use them

definitions.text: Riding breeches? No, but riders do use them

parts.words: Riding breeches? No, but riders do use them
parts.note: the word is slang for bulging thighs, which riding breeches might suggest, but literally means bags slung over a saddle

explanation.surface: Not the trousers a rider wears, but something riders carry.
explanation.walkthrough: The slang sense is fat thighs, like a pair of jodhpurs bulging; the clue denies that and points to the literal pouches carried on a horse or bike.
explanation.definitionFit: These are pouches fitted to a horse's or bicycle's seat, used by those who ride.

clue.text: Requirement for sewer near land the deed dealt with

indicators.note: dealt like a hand of cards, so the letters are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: A property deed is being handled for land near a drain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sewer' looks like a drain but means one who sews.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone stitching cloth needs a pointed tool and a strand of cotton to sew with.

clue.text: All being well, it should be empty

definitions.text: All being well, it should be empty

parts.words: All being well, it should be empty
parts.note: if everyone is healthy, the place that treats the sick will have no patients

explanation.surface: If all goes to plan, something will be vacant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'All being well' usually means 'if things go right'; here it means 'everyone in good health'.
explanation.definitionFit: A place for treating the ill or injured would have no patients if nobody were sick.

clue.text: Unusual car route for one in Brussels

indicators.note: unusual signals that the letters of car route appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: An odd driving route for someone working in Belgium's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A Eurocrat is an official of the European Union, whose institutions are based in Brussels.

clue.text: Remained a single and not disturbed

parts.note: what is left has remained behind
a lone one is a single, solitary one

explanation.surface: Someone stayed unmarried and was never bothered.
explanation.definitionFit: To be undisturbed is to be let be, with nobody interfering or bothering you.

clue.text: Intense dancing rife before getting caught with Ecstasy?

indicators.note: before getting places the jumbled letters ahead of the next pieces
dancing makes the letters of rife move about into a new order

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Wild partying is rampant before someone is busted with drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Fierce heat or competition is very strong, so the word is a synonym of intense.

clue.text: They represent us –- amen!

definitions.meaning: people who act on behalf of clients
split as A MEN, and men can be called gents, giving the answer

explanation.surface: A prayer of thanks for those who speak on our behalf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amen' is a whimsical second definition: read it as 'a men', i.e. 'a gents'.
explanation.definitionFit: Agents act on behalf of clients, representing them in deals or negotiations.

clue.text: Mourn eccentric old peer

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: A dotty elderly lord grieves.
explanation.definitionFit: To deplore is to lament or regret deeply, close to grieving over something.

clue.text: Light entertainment to repeat all over the place

indicators.note: scattered all over the place, the letters of to repeat are rearranged

explanation.surface: A light show that gets repeated everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: An operetta is a short comic opera with spoken dialogue, a lighthearted form of stage show.

clue.text: Married with ring –- outstanding

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O
to wed is to marry, so wed means married

explanation.surface: A newly married person still has the ring to pay for.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt still outstanding is one that remains unpaid and due.

clue.text: Problem that teacher's hidden

indicators.note: hidden says the answer is concealed within the letters of the following word

explanation.surface: A teacher is keeping some difficulty secret.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a persistent pain, a physical problem or trouble.

clue.text: One involved with erratic standards

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are mixed together

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A person mixed up with someone unpredictable has their standards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erratic' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'involved' mixes I into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Criteria are standards by which something is judged or measured.

clue.text: Outfit with energy grabbing silver in equestrian discipline

indicators.note: grabbing means the outfit and energy letters seize the silver symbol and hold it inside

parts.note: a dress is an outfit
E is the physics symbol for energy
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A vigorous outfit wearer snatches a silver medal at the horse show.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is the competitive training of horses in precise movements, an Olympic riding event.

clue.text: Water lily collection going to America

parts.note: a lot is a collection of items, as at auction
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A batch of aquatic flowers is being shipped to the States.
explanation.definitionFit: The sacred plant of Egypt and Asia is a type of water lily.
